The growing awareness from 2018–2021 fuels our demand to #stopspraying, as we seek accountability amid a façade of false mitigation narratives. Together, we must unearth the truth behind the trails above us! #climateaction #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying

As they bicker over peaking emissions and carbon sinks, they conveniently sidestep the toxic fallout from their spraying operations. The U.S. engages in political theatrics of joining and withdrawing, but this is about our survival! We must demand authentic #climateaction and #climatejustice by exposing #chemtrails and stopping the spraying that poisons our planet. It’s time to awaken and resist this covert assault on our environment! #geoengineering #stopspraying

history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are not just cute icons; they are essential indicators of our planet's health, and their survival is intricately linked to the melting sea ice. As the Arctic warms—twice the global average—the ice vanishes, threatening their hunting grounds. The misleading narrative that "polar bears are fine" due to stable subpopulations is a dangerous distraction from the reality: their very existence hinges on ice. With extended ice-free seasons, we are faced with catastrophic outcomes, including increased fasting and diminished cub survival rates. We must unveil the truth that polar bears are not thriving while planes continue to spray toxic chemicals across our skies. The real crisis lies in the loss of sea ice, exacerbated by pollution and misguided conservation efforts. It’s time to rise up for #climateaction and #climatejustice, demanding an immediate end to the spraying that exacerbates our climate emergency. We must #stopspraying to protect our polar bears and their icy habitats! #chemtrails #geoengineering.
